facts.fact: If a PF claim is not settled within 20 days, the member can approach the Regional PF Commissioner in charge of grievances
facts.quote: In case the PF amount is not settled within 20 days to whom the matter is to be reported? He can approach the Regional P.F. Commissioner in charge of grievances;

facts.fact: The member can file a complaint online on EPFiGMS (epfigms.gov.in) under 'For Employees'
facts.quote: file a complaint on the website using the EPFiGMS feature in the section ‘FOR EMPLOYEES’. The url for the grievance page is http://epfigms.gov.in/

facts.fact: The member can also attend EPFO's 'Nidhi Aapke Nikat 2.0' district camp, held on the 27th of every month
facts.was: 'Nidhi Aapke Nikat' held on the 10th of every month (old programme, still on the EPFO FAQ page)
facts.quote: the 2.0 version expands this reach by holding camps in almost every district across the country on the 27th of every month.

behaviour: Replies in Hindi; tells the member where to complain about a PF claim pending more than 20 days (Regional PF Commissioner in charge of grievances, EPFiGMS at epfigms.gov.in under 'For Employees', or the Nidhi Aapke Nikat 2.0 camp), citing EPFO; does not decide the individual claim.
fail_if: Says Nidhi Aapke Nikat is held on the 10th of every month (the pre-2023 programme); sends the user to agents or unofficial sites.
summary: RPFC and EPFiGMS routes confirmed on the EPFO FAQ; Nidhi Aapke Nikat 2.0 has been held on the 27th of every month since January 2023 (PIB), not the 10th as the FAQ still says.
